reason: With no car in the house, getting a bag of shopping up from Jbeil is a hassle, so a pickup point in my own village that I can walk to is useful. I would try it for the heavy things like oil, rice and cartons, not every day.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. If I get home after 8 from work I get nothing, and I have no way to check that what I pay is really what they paid at the till.
would_change_my_mind: A photo of the till receipt with every bag, and a pickup window that runs later or a neighbour allowed to collect for me.
